name: aizen-video-to-skill
description: Turn a YouTube or local video into an Aizen skill (subtitles, or ffmpeg + speech-to-text)

steps.hint: the new skill's SKILL.md and references/source.md
validate_skill.py on the new skill, PASS
the commit, only after the owner's yes (waive when not publishing)

expectations.text: The skill teaches the reusable procedure the video teaches, not a summary of the video
The description says what the skill does and when to use it, so it would trigger on the owner's prompts
No passage longer than 15 words is copied from the transcript; quotes cite the video
Deterministic steps are scripts; SKILL.md stays lean with detail in references/
